authorizedProductionChange.masterGate: Snapshot the master library roster and all linked-ID ownership before any diagnostic append; masterExternalLibrariesZero must use that immutable snapshot.
authorizedProductionChange.assetGate: After link=false append, require every newly appended collection/object/mesh/armature/material ID to have library=null; require any new descriptor to resolve only to the exact source asset; remove descriptors, require local IDs survive, then require exact cleanup.
authorizedProductionChange.reporting: Record initial master locality plus per-asset descriptor, ownership, survival and cleanup observations without removing any of the existing 23 checks.
authorizedProductionChange.forbidden: Removing a safety check, allowing linked IDs, allowing an unexpected descriptor path, changing asset identity/topology/rig logic, changing render tools or reclassifying retained v0.3.

authorizedDiagnostic.requiredResult: The corrected frozen production auditor independently reopens retained v0.3 and passes all 23 unchanged checks; an independent Node audit validates the report and output boundary.

promotionRule: Only D7 PASS authorizes a later C12 fresh formal retry. Retained v0.3 remains INVALIDATED and may not receive a replacement audit file.
